scientific_layer: source-fixed finite-dimensional second-response representation and UV bridge typing

theorem.source_solder: For each of the eight sectors, the retained BGCE288/BGCE290 source solder S_chi:A_10->Sym2(V4*) has rank ten and is therefore an isomorphism.
theorem.kernel_type: Schur-(2,2), algebraic-curvature type only; not identified with physical curvature
theorem.reason: Sym2(Sym2(V4*)) decomposes as Sym4(V4*) direct-sum Schur-(2,2). Total symmetrization is onto the first summand. Composing with the invertible Sym2(S_chi) preserves rank 35 and the 20-dimensional kernel in every sector.

actual_ub612_audit.why: The committed packet stores one actual 35-component U4 tensor and four root first derivatives, not the 55 source-pair columns required to test the actual ten-source Hessian. Reading U4 first and lifting it through a right inverse would be reconstruction, not source prediction.

counter_intuition_scan.strongest_counter_pattern: Surjectivity means every quartic target can be reconstructed after it is known, so rank 35 alone can be a representational tautology rather than a dynamical prediction.
counter_intuition_scan.ordinary_explanation: The plethysm decomposition is standard finite-dimensional tensor algebra once a rank-ten metric solder is supplied.
counter_intuition_scan.falsifier_for_next_gate: The actual PBM ten-source Hessian has rank below 35 in any sector, is absent under refinement, or requires target-dependent basis or coefficient fitting.

claim_ceiling: BGCE444 proves a coefficient-free source-fixed rank-35 algebraic second-response carrier with a retained 20-dimensional Schur-(2,2) kernel in all eight sectors. It does not prove that the actual UB612 U4 coefficients are generated by that response, an all-scale or renormalization theorem, ultraviolet finiteness, continuum quantum gravity, empirical gravity, RPD adoption, or Official SIEL adoption.
